## Design decisions

- **`public` earned narrowly** — only the five rows the record proves;
  every other surface keeps its prior layer. The release-workflow
  defect is recorded as part of the launch record, not footnoted.
- **PR #207 merged first** — the HUMAN-H7 records PR was still open at
  run start; merged under the launch sequence's recorded authorization
  (checks green), then this branch cut from the new `main`.
- **No new deferral, no deviation** — the zero-deferral rule held
  (deferrals-open.sh empty at start and close); no ADR owed.
- **Size budget TRIPPED — surfaced:** ~446 changed lines vs the 300
  budget (≈1.5×). Every deliverable is mandated (the launch record's
  49-crate verification table + incident log + protection evidence, the
  run ledger, this body); the overrun is recorded here, in the run
  ledger, the PHASE LOG entry and the BUILD_INDEX row — the
  recorded-deviation convention, no silent trim of required content.
